description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'NoRecordsFoundController' which extends an abstract Vue controller. It handles rendering a 'no-records-found' Vue component when invoked, likely in response to a search or data retrieval operation failing to find records. It resides within the 'Common' controllers of the OrangeHRM Core Plugin framework.

classes.name: NoRecordsFoundController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering a Vue component indicating no records were found.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the response by setting the 'no-records-found' Vue component for rendering.
